description: Randomized UR5/Panda workspace scenes with blocked straight-line start-goal pairs.

statistical_policy.baseline_metric: SBF and OMPL use v6-native runners; IRIS rows use Drake IRIS/GCS with generated OBJ collision URDFs

baseline_note: Exp.5 reuses Exp.3/4 paper SBF build/cached-query architecture, records build and query times separately, and performs an untimed per-scene LECT prewarm before SBF measurement. OMPL rows use the same v6-native C++ baseline_ompl runner and collision model as Exp.4; IRIS rows use Drake IRIS/GCS on generated OBJ collision URDFs with SceneGraphCollisionChecker validation.
